The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO), established in 1969, has positioned India among the elite spacefaring nations of the world. questionText:
Match List-I with List-II

List-I (Approaches to Human Development)
(A) Income Approach
(B) Welfare Approach
(C) Basic Needs Approach
(D) Capability Approach

List-II (Parameters)
(I) Building human abilities in the areas of health, education and access to resources
(II) People are not participants in development but only passive recipients
(III) The oldest approaches to human development

options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.
Correct answer. Correctly maps each entity across columns.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
NCERT Class 12 Fundamentals of Human Geography (Chapter 3: Human Development, 'Approaches to Human Development'):
- Income Approach: One of the oldest approaches, linking human development directly to income levels (III).
- Welfare Approach: Looks at human beings as beneficiaries or passive recipients of government expenditure on health, education, and amenities (II).
- Basic Needs Approach: Proposed by the International Labour Organisation (ILO), identifying six basic needs (IV).
- Capability Approach: Associated with Prof. Amartya Sen, focusing on building human capabilities in health, education, and resource access (I).
Matching: (A)-(III), (B)-(II), (C)-(IV), (D)-(I).
Hence, option (B) is the correct match.
